description: This file contains test cases for boundary and negative testing of a data encapsulation API, focusing on frame sizing, JSON validation, header validation, and segment handling in a FastAPI-based project.

classes.name: TestBoundaryCases
classes.description: Contains boundary condition tests such as maximum frame size, segmentation boundaries, and size limits.

classes.name: TestNegativeCases
classes.description: Contains negative tests for error handling including malformed JSON, missing fields, validation errors, and segment issues.

classes.name: TestHardwareDependentStubs
classes.description: Stub tests for hardware-dependent features, expected to fail or be skipped in CI environments.
